name: chaxport
description: A Chrome extension that cleans your Claude.ai conversation responses and exports them to PDF or JSON

scripts.build: bun run build:ts && bun run build:copy-assets
scripts.build:ts: bun build src/background.ts --outdir dist --target=browser --minify && bun build src/popup.ts --outdir dist --target=browser --minify && bun build src/content.ts --outdir dist --target=browser --minify
scripts.build:copy-assets: cp src/popup.html dist/popup.html && cp public/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp public/icons/* dist/
scripts.dev: bun run build:ts && bun run build:copy-assets
